TUITION $2,500 FLAGSHIP PROGRAM Dental Assisting Program Our accelerated program prepares you for an entry-level dental assisting job in 9 weeks (210 hours). All lectures and hands-on learning happen in our office at Waikiki Dental, with small classes and a 64-hour internship. Pick one class day — Monday, Friday, or Saturday — plus one internship day Chairside experience, resume help, and job assistance Ages 16+, no prerequisites Explore the program Ask about the next start BLS / CPR Initial or renewal BLS/CPR for healthcare providers with live skills practice. 3 hours $85 DBC IC189 Infection Control Board-approved 8-hour Infection Control course for dental assistants. 8 hours $395 DBC X1036 Radiation Safety 32-hour Radiation Safety course so you can take dental x-rays with confidence. 32 hours $695 DBC CP148 Coronal Polish 12-hour Coronal Polish course with lab, manikin, and clinical practice. 12 hours $500 DBC PF186 Pit & Fissure Sealants 16-hour Pit and Fissure Sealant course for eligible assistants and RDAs. 16 hours $550 HeartCode BLS — $85 Now offering blended learning: complete the online portion at home, then come in for a skills test. Call to schedule your skills evaluation and bring proof of online completion. Link for online portion N95 Fit Test — $89.99 Initial and annual qualitative fit testing with a TSI Portacount to help offices meet OSHA requirements. By appointment; each additional mask is $20. Book Appointment Here Implant & bone grafting coaching One-on-one, hands-on coaching for dentists with Dr. Michael Narodovich — guided and free-hand implant placement, bone grafting, and sinus augmentation, with your own patients. Request next steps Graduation day WHY DENTAL ASSISTING? A career that opens doors A fast, hands-on way into healthcare — with steady demand, flexible hours, and room to grow. 15.3% Employment Outlook Dental Assistants jobs are expected to increase by 15.3% between 2018 and 2028. $18–22 Median Wage Starting pay is between $18 - $22 depending on your state and employer. PT · FT Flexible Schedules Dental assisting gives you an opportunity to have a work/life balance. Full time, part time, and temping positions allows for a flexible work schedule. Not to mention most offices have evenings, weekends, and holidays off. DA → RDA Multiple Career Paths Being a Dental Assistant is the stepping stone into the dental field. You will explore a variety of career options the dental field has to offer. As a dental assistant you will have the knowledge to make an easy transition to another role in dentistry. Dental Board Course Details Approval status, requirements, and what to bring — clear before anyone enrolls. Approved course lists The Dental Board of California advises applicants to verify programs and courses through the official approved-provider lists before enrolling. View Dental Board lists Roseville course approvals Current public Dental Board lists show Roseville Dental Academy for Radiation Safety X1036, Infection Control IC189, Coronal Polishing CP148, and Pit and Fissure Sealants PF186.
